title.zh: 法律专业（临时认许）公告 2012

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Legal Profession (Ad Hoc Admissions) Notification 2012 and shall come into operation on 1st April 2012.

2. In this Notification, unless the context otherwise requires —
“foreign senior counsel” means a person who holds —
(a)Her Majesty’s Patent as Queen’s Counsel; or
(b)any appointment of equivalent distinction of any jurisdiction;
“Senior Counsel” means an advocate and solicitor appointed as Senior Counsel under section 30 of the Act.

heading.en: Matters specified under section 15(6A) of Act
